nodes.label: Full prefetch of 12 sidebar sections
nodes.rationale: prefetch=true in Next 16 server-renders whole dynamic page; ~13 AppShell renders per load with stale data up to 5 min. Fixed: prefetch only on intent, staleTimes.static 300s->30s.

nodes.label: Deploy a Vercel workflow
nodes.rationale: Vercel Hobby Git integration only accepts commits from the project owner account; deploying via CLI with the owner's token avoids author checks across multiple Vercel accounts (one per client).

nodes.label: VERCEL_TOKEN / VERCEL_ORG_ID / VERCEL_PROJECT_ID secrets
nodes.rationale: Without the secrets the workflow warns and exits instead of failing.

nodes.label: Carlos-Dominguez-faber/whatsapp-saas reference repo
nodes.rationale: Use as module-by-module reference, don't clone over: project already has real data, connected Supabase and own changes; never mix migrations without reviewing RLS.

nodes.label: GHL purchase webhook auto-provisioning (/api/webhooks/ghl/purchase)
nodes.rationale: Only proceeds when contact has tag cliente-levy; reuses existing company for same email.

nodes.label: INTEGRATION_ENCRYPTION_KEY
nodes.rationale: Changing it makes stored per-company secrets undecryptable; they must be re-entered.

nodes.label: /api/health/readiness preflight
nodes.rationale: Returns 200/503; requires CRON_SECRET or superadmin since it exposes which env vars exist.

nodes.norm_label: conversational flow builder with human review

nodes.label: Inbox por empresa (IA / handoff / onboarding views)
nodes.norm_label: inbox por empresa (ia / handoff / onboarding views)

nodes.norm_label: levy multi-tenant whatsapp ai agent panel

nodes.label: Next.js breaking changes notice (read node_modules/next/dist/docs)
nodes.rationale: This Next.js version has breaking API/convention changes vs training data; read bundled docs before writing code.

nodes.label: 20s per-conversation AI response buffer
nodes.rationale: Webhook opens a buffer, groups messages for 20s, calls /api/cron/buffer then /api/cron/deliver; AI does not wait for the cron.

nodes.label: Onboarding kickoff meeting (step 3) on AAA001 calendar
nodes.norm_label: onboarding kickoff meeting (step 3) on aaa001 calendar
nodes.rationale: Uses AAA001's existing GHL connection so no new key is needed; if unavailable the step shows support WhatsApp instead of disappearing. Slots cached 1 min; page doesn't wait if GHL > 2.5s.

nodes.label: Vercel daily crons (flows, deliver, ghl-sync)
nodes.rationale: Hobby plan rejects deploys with crons more frequent than daily; this silently froze production for several commits. Real cadence needs Vercel Pro or an external scheduler (cron-job.org, QStash).

nodes.label: Inbox polling 3.5s with visibility pause and backoff
nodes.norm_label: inbox polling 3.5s with visibility pause and backoff
nodes.rationale: Unconditional polling caused ~1030 invocations/hour per tab; now pauses when hidden, backoff to 10s.

nodes.label: Supabase Realtime for inbox (pending)
nodes.rationale: Would truly eliminate polling but needs DB publication changes and RLS review; deferred to separate decision.

nodes.label: Per-workspace integrations encrypted AES-256-GCM
nodes.rationale: Keys stored encrypted in DB per company, never as global env vars.

nodes.label: Automatic human handoff
nodes.rationale: Conversation moves to the human inbox if the contact asks, the AI cannot answer, or the AI promises a human.
